caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster canopy bed positioned against the corner of a room with light-colored walls and a wood floor. The bed has dark blue or black wooden posts and frame, supporting a rectangular canopy with a plain white top and white drapes hanging down on either side. The edges of the canopy and curtains are trimmed with a multicolored decorative border. The curtains are tied back on the left and at the back, exposing the bed. The bed is covered with a white bedspread, pillow, and dust ruffle, all adorned with bright, multicolored floral embroidery in red, blue, yellow, and green. The floral patterns are intricate and varied, covering the surfaces of the bedding and curtains. The overall composition focuses on the bed, which occupies most of the image, with the walls and floor rendered in soft, neutral tones as the background.
title: Bedstead
